children: Novo Nordisk A/S Sponsored ADR Class B (OMXCOP:NOVO_B) is reshaping operations—DKK15bn buyback, DKK8bn cost cuts and 9,000 job reductions—while balancing Wegovy-led sales and expansions with trial setbacks, competition from Eli Lilly, denecimig EU progress and U.S. pricing shifts.
Previous Week Recap
Novo Nordisk Buyback Progress
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) launched a DKK15bn buyback Feb 4, 2026. By Sep 11, 2026 repurchased 33,084,179 B shares for DKK9.326bn (avg DKK281.89); treasury 47,124,876 B shares (1.1%).
Trials Halt Raise Growth Concerns
: NOVO_B: Trials for heart drug ziltivekimab halted and prior setback for obesity candidate CagriSema noted, raising investor concern about growth beyond Wegovy.
U.S. Market Share Shift
: NOVO_B: U.S. obesity market share ~38.8% vs rival 60.9%. Reported 3M+ U.S. oral Wegovy prescriptions in five months; Q2 sales DKK 3.2bn. Pricing changes and expanded direct sales.
Positive FREHEMGO Opinion
: NOVO_B: EMA CHMP gave positive opinion for FREHEMGO (denecimig) for haemophilia A after Phase 3 showed lower bleeding rates and acceptable safety. EU launches planned Q4 2026; FDA review ongoing.
Q2 Op Profit And Sales
: NOVO_B Q2: adjusted operating profit DKK33.39bn on sales DKK78.49bn (adj. op. margin ~42.5%). U.S. depositary shares trading near $42.13 vs GF fair value $105.13 (~60% gap).
Wegovy Cleared In China
: NOVO_B: Wegovy cleared in China for MAFLD—the first GLP‑1 approved for that indication. Pediatric trial: 40.4% of 6–<12 patients no longer obese after 68 weeks.
Lagging Outlook And Patent Risks
: NOVO_B lagged Eli Lilly in 2026; reported a late‑stage anti‑inflammatory trial failure and faces an upcoming patent cliff—key risks for traders assessing Novo Nordisk exposure.
Job Cuts And Savings
: NOVO_B plans to cut about 9,000 jobs (~11% workforce) and target DKK 8bn annual savings by end-2026 as it restructures amid competition in obesity and diabetes markets.
Frontier Denecimig Bleed Reduction

: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B): FRONTIER trials show denecimig cut annual bleeds vs prior factor or on‑demand therapy; 61 patients switched from emicizumab to denecimig pen without washout, no clots reported.
MFN Pricing With Medicare
: NOVO_B joined MFN pricing with Medicaid/Medicare last year, cutting prices on several drugs — mainly weight‑loss treatments — to match prices in other developed countries, aiding Medicare access.
